meta.summary: Saudi Arabia and Türkiye deepen defense ties alongside Pakistan, while election milestones unfold in Morocco, South Sudan, and Brazil.

DNK-USA.note: NATO allies; a Sept 22, 2026 deal grants the US new Arctic bases and broad access in Greenland, easing friction over earlier US annexation talk.

IRN-ISR.note: Open war since Feb 2026 strikes that killed Ali Khamenei; June truce collapsed in July

IRN-SAU.note: Iranian missiles hit Saudi cities and refineries since Feb 2026; Riyadh struck back; Iran now offers a halt

IRN-USA.note: At war since Feb 2026 US-Israeli strikes; US naval blockade of Iran; talks at UNGA on a 60-day regional ceasefire

SAU-YEM.note: 2022 truce is over: Houthis strike Riyadh and Yanbu, seize the Red Sea coast and ban Saudi ships

BEL-RWA.note: Diplomatic ties are restored after an 18-month rupture over the conflict in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).

IRQ-TUR.note: Ankara and Baghdad agree on the handover of the Bashiqa military base to Iraqi forces amid security cooperation in Sinjar.

USA-VEN.note: Deep confrontation persists, though acting leader Delcy Rodriguez and Donald Trump hold talks on debt restructuring and ties.

COL-IRN.note: Colombia cuts diplomatic ties with Iran and designates the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) as a terrorist organization.

CAN-VNM.note: Canada and Vietnam establish a formal Strategic Partnership to elevate bilateral economic and security cooperation.

SAU-TUR.note: Saudi Arabia and Türkiye deepen military and intelligence cooperation alongside Pakistan under a joint defense agreement.

COL-USA.note: Long-time security partner; bilateral relations reset under President Abelardo de la Espriella.

houthi-red-sea.d: Iran-armed Houthis, who hit Red Sea shipping from 2023, reopened war on Saudi Arabia in 2026 and in September seized Yemen's side of Bab-el-Mandeb. With Hormuz disrupted, Saudi oil exports rerouted to the Red Sea are now the target; Egypt's Suez revenue suffers while the US stays out and the UK sends limited help to Riyadh.

bab-el-mandeb.d: Links the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden. In Sept 2026 the Houthis took Mocha, Perim (Mayyun) and the Hanish Islands, controlling Yemen's side of the strait just as Saudi exports shifted to the Red Sea.
bab-el-mandeb.s: Houthi-held since Sept 2026 · Saudi ships banned

pituffik-space-base.d: Missile-warning radar in Greenland. A Sept 22, 2026 US-Denmark agreement added two further US sites, at Narsarsuaq and Mestersvig, with broad air and undersea access, easing friction from Trump's earlier annexation talk.
pituffik-space-base.s: Northernmost US base; 2 more Greenland sites added Sept 2026

strait-of-hormuz.d: The only sea exit from the Persian Gulf. Commercial vessels face missile attacks amid the conflict, including a fatal strike off Oman in September 2026.
strait-of-hormuz.s: US blockade of Iran · fatal MV Cape Dao strike Sept 2026
